KSI-604-RW

Infant Radiant Warmer

An open-care warmer for newborns at risk of heat loss — for NICUs, labour rooms and nurseries.

Consists of a cart, bassinet, heater module with examination light, and a pillar module housing the controller and SMPS. A removable instrument tray mounts at the rear.
